From first visit to final fitting

  1. 1. Visit and measure. We come to you, listen, and take exact measurements.
  2. 2. Quote and sketch. You get a written price and a simple drawing before any work starts.
  3. 3. Build. Seasoned wood, proper joinery, and updates along the way.
  4. 4. Fit and check. We install, clean up and go through everything with you before final payment.

Questions, answered

Is the site visit really free?

Yes. We visit, measure and give a written quote at no charge.

How long does a job take?

A door or small repair takes a few days. A wardrobe or kitchen usually takes two to four weeks. You get the date in writing.

Can I give my own design?

Yes. Send us a photo or a sketch of what you want, along with the size of your space, and we will quote and build it for you.

How do I pay?

Cash, bank transfer, JazzCash or Easypaisa. An advance covers materials, and the balance is due after you approve the finished work.
